children: Zoomcar's revenue fell 13% year over year, with 9% of the decrease attributed to currency fluctuations in converting INR to USD. Earnings turned to profit from a year-earlier loss, primarily reflecting $2.46 million in non-cash gains on the fair value of shares issued to settle litigation.

: Booking Days totaled approximately 155,869, compared with 179,898 a year earlier; gross booking value was approximately $5.29 million versus $6.23 million.
: Cost of revenue declined 27%, including lower repair and maintenance costs, personnel costs and software support expenses.
: Technology and development costs fell 40%, while general and administrative expenses declined 38%, reflecting lower employee and professional fees.
: The non-GAAP measure increased to $1.22 million from $1.20 million; contribution margin rose to 61% from 52%.
